sinks.name: saveConcessionReport
sinks.payload:
{
        concession_id: concessionId,
        department_id: v.department_id || null,
        written_on: v.written_on,
        result: v.result.trim() || null,
        qc_effect:
          v.qc_effect === "yes" || v.qc_effect === "no" ? v.qc_effect : null,
        final_disposition: v.final_disposition
          ? (v.final_disposition as never)
          : null,
        processed_qty: intOrNull(v.processed_qty),

        reinspection_id: null,
        handling_overview: v.handling_overview.trim() || null,
        request_content: v.request_content.trim() || null,
        review_content: v.review_content.trim() || null,
        handling_content: v.handling_content.trim() || null,
        result_detail: v.result_detail.trim() || null,
        followup_action: v.followup_action.trim() || null,
      }
